messages:
claire: Heads up — Acme wants to sign the orderform but asked for signer delegation (PO team can sign invoices, legal wants exec sign on MSA). They also redlined DPA section on KMS + subprocessing. attaching orderform and redlines: https://drive.example/acme/orderform.pdf

michael (customer): yep, we need PO flow where finance signs invoices, legal signs MSA. prefer DocuSign. can the orderform allow delegated signer?

devin: quick Q for legal — delegation clause ok if we add signer roles on orderform? also pricing question: they asked for a 12% discount for committed volume during POC — is that allowed for a POC discount matrix?

jason (legal): we can accept delegated invoice signer, but need an explicit "Authorized Signatory" block + counterparty attest. DPA/KMS redline: we can't agree to customer-managed keys in hosted offering; we can offer Dedicated/Private options. will propose language: "Customer may request dedicated deployment with KMS integration subject to SOC2+ contract amendment."

amy (procurement): net terms request: Net45 from finance. also they want PO # on every invoice and a billing contact. who will handle invoice attachments and delivery?

sara (sales-ops): DocuSign routing: we can set up envelope with two signers: "MSA exec" (signs MSA) and "Finance (invoices)" (signs orderform addendum). we usually do sequential signing: exec -> finance. if they want delegation, we can allow role-based signing with a delegated email. sample envelope settings:```{
  "routing": "sequential",
  "signers": [
    {"role":"exec","email":"exec@acme.com"},
    {"role":"finance","email":"finance@acme.com","allow_delegation":true}
  ]
}```

claire: @jason can you drop the proposed MSA/DPA patch into the redlines doc? i'll update the orderform to include "PO billing contact" field and email. @sara will set the envelope.

jason (legal): uploading patch now — link: https://drive.example/acme/msadpa_redlines_v2.docx. Key change for DPA: remove "customer-managed key guarantee" and add "option for Dedicated deployment with KMS integration subject to separate SOW." Also added audit window language.

contracts-bot: Document uploaded by jason (legal): msadpa_redlines_v2.docx (sha256: abc123...)

devin: Regarding POC discount, we can't commit to permanent pricing adjustments in the orderform. propose a one-time POC credit line instead. @zoe do we have a POC credit template?

zoe (finance): we have a standard POC credit clause: "Customer will receive a one-time credit up to $X applied to first invoice following POC completion." i'll draft numbers after you confirm target credit.

michael (customer): one-time credit sounds fine. priority is signing fast — can we get a countersigned MSA and orderform this week?

claire: aim is EOW. action items: @jason to finalize redline by noon, @sara to prepare DocuSign envelope with delegation enabled, @amy to confirm Net45 acceptance and billing contact field, @zoe to draft POC credit clause. i'll own the orderform edit and send to customer for signature once redline accepted.

jason (legal): done — redline posted. small note: we need exec full name on MSA signature block; customer should populate.

amy (procurement): Net45 accepted. billing contact: invoices@acme-payables.com. adding clause to orderform.

sara (sales-ops): envelope ready. using routing sequentail -> exec then finance. included delegation checkbox for finance signer. preview link: https://docusign.example/envelope/preview/4567

claire: sending now. @michael please confirm once signed so we can hand off to finance for PO. :thumbsup:

michael (customer): signed both, got exec and finance signatures via delegated flow. thanks everyone.

claire: awesome — closing. i'll attach signed copies to the CRM and kick billing. final note: keep a copy of the redline patch in contract folder for audits. :white_check_mark:
